comment: A back quiver: a stitched leather tube with a turned wooden base, worn on the BACK (kind quiver, EquipSlotId::Back). The bow draws a random arrow out of the worn one (game/quiver.h). Drawn render-only on the rig's `back` socket by its `back` grip (the tube's +x is its mouth; the arrows stand in from there); the hilt box is the strap's middle, the point that sits on the socket. Regenerate with scripts/gen_quiver_item.py.
name: back_quiver
